# Chargement des données labels

```{r}

path <- "datas"
labels <- fread(paste(path, 'MorphoMNIST_Test.csv', sep = '/'), data.table = F, sep = ",",  header = TRUE, index = FALSE)
labels

```



```{r}
names(labels)
summary(labels)

```


```{r}

for(i in 1:length(names(labels))){
  hist(labels[[i]], breaks = min(50, length(unique(labels[[i]]))), main = colnames(labels)[i], xlab = names(labels)[i])
}

```


```{r}

sapply(labels, class)
labels$number <- as.factor(labels$number)
sapply(labels, class)

```



```{r}
           #   "area" "thickness" "slant" "width" "height" "number" 
effectifs <- c(  5,     5,           5,      5,       5,      10)
data_disc <- discretize(
  labels,
  method  = "hartemink",
  breaks  = effectifs,
  ibreaks = 20
)


for(i in 1:length(names(labels))){
  barplot(table(data_disc[[i]]), main = colnames(labels)[i])
}

names(data_disc)
# rm(labels)
# rm(morpho.mnist)

```



```{r}

data_disc

```





```{r}

path <- "datas"
path <- paste(path, paste0('Morpho_test - discrete - intervals - ',  paste(effectifs, collapse = "_"), '.csv'), sep = '/')
path

```



```{r}


write.csv(data_disc, path,  row.names = FALSE)
          
          
```




```{r}

for(i in 1:5){
  levels(data_disc[[i]]) <- 0:(length(levels(data_disc[[i]])) -1)
}
data_disc

```


```{r}

path <- "datas"
path <- paste(path, paste0('Morpho_test - discrete - ',  paste(effectifs, collapse = "_"), '.csv'), sep = '/')
path


```



```{r}

write.csv(data_disc, path, row.names = FALSE)

```
